propositions: tests/unit/test_build_provenance.py rebuilds identical clean-source artifacts three times per test session, causing unnecessary slowdown (baseline 35.93s)
The module performs one identical successful build with REBAR_BUILD_COMMIT=abc1234 in four separate tests instead of reusing a single session-scoped prerequisite artifact

Wheel-from-sdist, sdist-content, and install-from-sdist tests can share immutable read-only artifact paths from a single prerequisite build without compromising their archive-content or rebuild-boundary assertions

A session-scoped per-worker fixture returning only immutable wheel and sdist paths, combined with function-scoped extraction for distinct env-unset rebuild and empty-env failure cases, reduces redundant work while preserving all real build boundaries and provenance coverage
